# Ticket of Eternal Keep 1.3.7 for Minecraft 26.3

This release updates Ticket of Eternal Keep for Minecraft 26.3.

## Changes

- Updated Minecraft compatibility to 26.3.
- Updated Fabric Loader and Fabric API dependencies for Minecraft 26.3.
- Preserved the existing ticket behavior and configuration introduced in 1.3.7.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API 0.160.5 or newer
- Java 25

The optional server-side resource pack is included with the GitHub release for vanilla clients that need the custom ticket texture.
